craft_notes: SthAyin: SAnta as saMsAra denied — tranquility of no-rite (C1 rasa). Verse color: denial that steadies. Firing rows: double prohibition (row 9 anaphora abandon/grasp — already in L3); fourfold heap catalogue (row 2 density kept whole); end-weight staying (yathAvasthita — the whole anupAya doctrine in the last word); close-shape settles (SAnta-fall: live-healthy-staying). L4 = L3 verbatim: adorning a verse that refuses method would contradict its doctrine — restraint IS the music here.

lines: For body-bearers, Saṃsāra in truth is not — of bondage, what news?
Bondage never truly is anyone’s — so the liberation-rite is false.
This error-maker: rope-snake-shadow-ghost delusion. Abandon nothing; grasp nothing —
live healthy, staying as you are.
